claim: Some keys (e.g. review policy, hook private-network allow, execution sandbox) are read only from operator scopes (user/system/system-defaults) so a cloned repo cannot set them.
label: from-official-docs

claim: Opt-in tools.executionSandbox {backend auto|bwrap|landlock, filesystem workspace-write, network closed} on Linux (workspace settings cannot change it), plus legacy whole-CLI sandbox (Docker/Podman/Seatbelt).
label: from-official-docs

claim: Hooks under 'hooks' in settings (PreToolUse etc., command hooks with QWEN_PROJECT_DIR/CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR); project-agent hooks recheck trust; security.allowedHttpHookUrls / allowPrivateNetworkHooks (operator scopes only).
label: from-official-docs

claim: MCP servers under mcpServers (Gemini-style entries: command,args,env,url,httpUrl,headers,trust,...) in settings.json; project servers are subject to folder trust only when trust is enabled.
label: from-official-docs

claim: Qwen OAuth free tier discontinued 2026-04-15; current auth: Alibaba ModelStudio, third-party providers, custom provider; modelProviders keyed openai|anthropic|gemini|vertex-ai with baseUrl and envKey; keys may be stored plaintext in settings.json 'env'.
label: from-official-docs

claim: Local models: modelProviders.openai[] with baseUrl http://localhost:11434/v1 and OLLAMA_API_KEY=ollama; Anthropic protocol also supported via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.

claim: qwen serve daemon binds 127.0.0.1:4170 with bearer auth off by default; any local process can use the operator API including code execution as the daemon user; non-loopback binds always carry a bearer token.

claim: Auto-memory plus optional team memory (.qwen/team-memory/, git-tracked, secret-scanned) and Mem0; QWEN.md/AGENTS.md instruction files.
